shots.speaker: narrator
shots.narration: आधी रात हो चुकी थी। वार्ता अभी चल रही थी।
shots.caption: आधी रात
shots.visual: Extreme close on a brass oil lamp wick. It gutters. Behind it, out of focus, voices. A hand enters and steadies the lamp.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.narration: श्रीगोकुलनाथजी चौरासी वैष्णवन की वार्ता कर रहे थे। कल्याणभट्ट और सब वैष्णव सुन रहे थे।
shots.caption: चौरासी वैष्णवन की वार्ता
shots.visual: Slow tilt down from the lamp to a seated semicircle. Gokulnathji on a chowki, gesturing. Kalyanbhatt beside him. Twelve figures in shadow beyond.
shots.camera: slow tilt down, 12 figures suggested not counted

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.narration: वार्ता के रस में वे इतने डूब गये कि श्रीसुबोधिनी की कथा कहना भूल गये।
shots.caption: रस में डूबे
shots.visual: Gokulnathji's profile, eyes half closed, a faint smile. Lamp light from below. The manuscript lies forgotten, open, at his knee.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.caption: कथा भूल गई
shots.visual: Shadows stretch across the floor. The lamp burns low. The open manuscript's pages lift in a faint draught.
shots.camera: static wide-low on the floor, shadows moving

shots.speaker: young-vaishnav
shots.caption: कब कहोगे?
shots.visual: The young Vaishnav leans forward from the back row, hands together. Heads turn toward him. His face stays in shadow.
shots.camera: over-shoulder from the assembly toward the questioner
shots.sfx: a single voice in the quiet

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.caption: आधी रात गई
shots.visual: Silence. Gokulnathji's hands resting on his knees. The lamp flame steadies — the wick sound stops.
shots.camera: tight on hands, everything else black

shots.speaker: gokulnathji
shots.narration: आज मैं कथाका फल कह रहा हूँ।
shots.caption: कथाका फल
shots.visual: First look at his eyes. He opens them and looks up. Warm light rises from the lamp and fills his face. The room brightens by a stop.
shots.camera: slow push in to the eyes; first reveal of the face

shots.speaker: gokulnathji
shots.narration: सारा फल वैष्णव की बात में है। वैष्णव से बढ़कर और कोई पदार्थ नहीं है।
shots.caption: फल वैष्णवकी वातमें
shots.visual: The camera drifts across listening faces — Kalyanbhatt, an old woman, a potter, a Kshatri — each lit for a moment by the same lamp.
shots.camera: slow lateral drift, one face at a time

shots.speaker: gokulnathji
shots.narration: यह पुष्टिमार्ग है — वैष्णव के द्वारा ही फलित होता है।
shots.caption: यह पुष्टिमार्ग
shots.visual: The lamp flame reflected in a brass vessel. In the reflection, not the room: a single devotee's bowed head. For one beat, Damodardas's silhouette in the back row.
shots.camera: macro on the reflection, then a half-beat cut to the back row

shots.speaker: gokulnathji
shots.narration: श्रीआचार्यजीने भी कहा — दमला, ये मार्ग तेरे लिये प्रकट किया है। इसलिये वैष्णव की वार्ता सर्वोपरि है।
shots.caption: वार्ता सर्वोपरि
shots.visual: Gokulnathji's hand comes to rest on the closed manuscript. The lamp flame in the same frame.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.narration: तो चलिए शुरुआत करते हैं श्री दामोदरदास हरसानी वैष्णव की वार्ता १ वार्ता प्रसंग १ से... जय श्री कृष्ण!
shots.caption: जय श्री कृष्ण
shots.visual: Wide cinematic view of the sacred assembly under the moonlit Kadamba tree. Campfire glows warmly against the night sky as stars twinkle above.
shots.camera: slow pull back, warm campfire glow, holding on the peaceful assembly
shots.sfx: soft temple bell chime, tanpura resolves
